_status: TO BE VERIFIED BY A LICENSED ENGINEER. The tolerance is a drawing tolerance chosen for the editor, not a value from any standard or building code.
_doc: coreSpaceTypes: the space types that form the vertical core and must line up from floor to floor. tolerance: how far (metres) the outline of a core space may differ from the one directly above or below before a warning is shown. Outlines are compared at the inside wall faces.
